behaviors.statement: Relationship scoring is asymmetric: a directed signal changes score(A->B) without changing score(B->A).
Every signal contributes exactly its bucket weight (1, 2 or 3) or zero. No partial firings, no learned weights.
The status-gradient signal S8 cannot fire unless a substrate signal (S2, S3, S5 or S7) has already fired; prominence breaks ties but never creates a match.
A match is surfaced only at score >= 6 with at least one of S3/S5/S7 fired; otherwise the Room block reports no strong match rather than forcing one.
The rendered card body is 250-350 words. Outside the band is a hard gate failure.
The card has exactly five ordered bare-noun blocks: Who, Now, Room, Notice, Say. The last block is a sayable line, not a fact.
Every fact rendered on the card carries resolvable provenance. A fact with no source cannot render.
An inferred fact must name the facts it was composed from, or it cannot render.
A stale profile degrades honestly: the Now block states the trail is cold rather than presenting old material as current or fabricating recency.
A source measured as blocked returns empty and is recorded as unavailable; it is never fabricated or silently substituted.
Ranking is deterministic: ties break by LARGE-signal count, then evidence recency, then member id.
The reason sentence names only signals that actually fired.
An empty room produces a valid card with an honest Room block, not an error and not a fabricated match.
Digest generation is idempotent: the same arrival against the same roster and cache yields the same card.
Evaluation gates on structure and grades on content: gate failures fail the digest outright; content quality is scored with partial credit.
